item.coloph: rig 'dzin kun grol gsang ba rtsal gyis dag pa'i brda don zab mo thabs shes rten 'brel las kyi sgo bags 'byed bzhin du/ mos skal dang ldan pas bskul ngor bkra shis bsam 'grub seng rdzong gi khrod du gtan la phab pa'i dge tshogs kyis/ bstan 'dzin mchog rnams gsang gsum phrin las dang bcas pa'i zhabs pad skal brtan brgyar cing / gsang mtshan zab mo'i bstan pa kun tu rgyas nas snyigs ma'i rgud pa bya byed las kyi dngos po dang bcas pa myur du zhi ba'i smon pa dang bcas te sarba mang+ga lam//

item.tib: bder gshegs dgongs pa kun 'dus las bla ma dgongs 'dus kyi rig 'dzin klu yi dbang po'i cho ga
item.coloph: rig 'dzin kun sgrol (grol) rtsal gyi dag pa'i brda don zab mo thabs shes rten 'brel las kyi sgo brgya 'byed bzhin mos skal dang ldan pas bskul ngor bkra shis bsam 'grub seng rdzong gi khrod du gtan la phab pa'i dge tshogs gyis bstan 'dzin mchog rnams gsang gsum phrin las dang bcas pa'i zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan cing gsang chen zab mo'i bstan pa kun tu rgyas nas snyigs ma'i rgud pa bya byed las kyi dang po dang bcas pa myur du zhi ba'i smon pa dang bcas te sarba mang+ga lam//
